title: Sales Representative list starts with Unassigned, then reps by first name
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Three active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A}, {Sales-rep-B} and {Sales-rep-C}. {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B} share a first name; {Sales-rep-C} has a later first name.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able, {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Brook and {Sales-rep-C} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able (first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ann" or "ZZAUTOTEST Ben").
  • Staff member {Staff-member-D} is active at {Location-A} with the "Sales Representative" switch off.
    For example: {Staff-member-D} is ZZAUTOTEST Dan Noswitch.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its card shows one "Sales Representative" field reading "Unassigned".
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the Sales Representative field.
  2. Read the options in the dropdown from top to bottom.
  3. Look for a search box in the dropdown.
  4. Look for {Staff-member-D} in the list.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: a dropdown opens under the field.
  • Step 2: the first option is "Unassigned" and it is checked. The sales representatives follow, sorted by first name, then last name, A to Z, so {Sales-rep-A} comes before {Sales-rep-B}, and {Sales-rep-B} before {Sales-rep-C}.
  • Step 3: there is no search box.
  • Step 4: {Staff-member-D} is not listed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S1-R8, S1-R9, S1-R12, S1-N2, read 19 Oct 2026. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R8: “Clicking the field opens a dropdown. Its first option is "Unassigned", followed by every active sales representative, sorted by first name, then last name, A to Z.”
  • S1-R9: “The option for the person in the field is checked. With nobody assigned, "Unassigned" is checked.”
  • S1-R12: “The dropdown has no search box.”
  • S1-N2: “A staff member whose Sales Representative switch is off is not listed and cannot be picked. If one is sent by any other route, the system refuses it with "The selected staff member is not a sales representative."”
